dynamic.description: The main change is replacing the parent's potentially saturating additive rule with a deliberately damped, scale-aware mapping: workload and progress favor H0, while machine readiness and alternative density favor H1. Dispersion remains a modest risk-sensitive adjustment, and previous-member persistence is retained only as a small categorical tie-break signal.
